title: Materials
lead: We specialise in HDPE and PP — two polyolefins that are notoriously hard to print at scale. We do it daily, and we make our own recyclate in-house.

items.name: HDPE
items.body: Strong, impact-resistant, chemical-resistant and weatherproof. UV-stable with the right compound. Fully recyclable. For industrial applications, marine, storage tanks, facade elements.

items.name: PP
items.body: Lighter than HDPE, higher melting point, excellent fatigue resistance. Suited for living-hinge applications, automotive trim, lab equipment.

items.name: Food-grade HDPE
items.body: HDPE with EU certification for food contact. For production environments, food processing, dispenser parts, cookware components.

recycle_body: We use industrial offcuts directly from the production line of our parent company, Kuypers Kunststoftechniek. No post-consumer mixed streams, no unknown contamination — single-stream, traceable, and in quality equivalent to virgin material. By default we run a blend; 100% recyclate is available on request.
